candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 on POST /v1/orders and gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout; inventory/reservations succeed, so the failure originates in the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; the internal cause of the 503 (crash, saturation, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent 503 from payment on /v1/authorizations, propagated as 502 through order to gateway checkout, while inventory reservations return 200. Gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. Root cause is bounded to the payment dependency, but its internal failure mode is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics for the 503 window to identify the internal failure mode
Payment service version/deployment facts to rule out a bad rollout
